text:
1. 7. 10

Lokasuttaṃ

(Devatā:)

70. . ] Kismiṃ loko samuppanno kismiṃ kubbati santhavaṃ, 

Kissa loko upādāya kismiṃ loko vihaññatīti. 

(Bhagavā:) chassu loko samuppanno chassu kubbati santhavaṃ, 

Channameva upādāya chassu loko vihaññatīti. 

Anvavaggo sattamo. 

Tatruddānaṃ:

Nāmaṃ cittañca taṇhā ca saṃyojanañca bandhanā, 

Abbhāhatuḍḍito pihito icchā lokena te dasāti. 

8. Jhatvā vaggo
